set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
WARM="$BASE/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh"
echo -n "WARM_MODE="; stat -c '%a' "$WARM"
echo -n "WARM_SHA256="; sha256sum "$WARM" | awk '{print $1}'
echo -n "WARM_CRON_COUNT="; (crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -F -c "$WARM" || true
"$BASE/envs/openwebui/bin/python" - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,json
db="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/openwebui-data/webui.db"
ids=["ahsoka-tano","deepseek-r1:1.5b","gemma3:270m","granite4.2:3b","lfm2.5:8b-a1b-q4_K_M","local-agent-mini-c-agent","ornith:latest","qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M","qwen3:4b-instruct"]
c=sqlite3.connect("file:"+db+"?mode=ro",uri=True); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; c.execute("pragma query_only=on")
for mid in ids:
 r=c.execute("select id,params,updated_at from model where id=?",(mid,)).fetchone()
 p=json.loads(r["params"] or "{}")
 print(mid,json.dumps({"updated_at":r["updated_at"],"keep_alive":p.get("keep_alive"),"num_ctx":p.get("num_ctx"),"num_thread":p.get("num_thread")},separators=(",",":")))
